We have had net cash flows used in operating activities for the Financial Years 2026, 2025 and 2024 and net cash flows used in financing activities for the Financial Year 2026 and we may continue to have a net used cash position in the future.

Our efforts to acquire new users, clients and customers of our business and retain them may not be successful or may be more costly than we expect, which could prevent us from maintaining or increasing our revenue.
